subject: gargoyle
pitch:
Category: Monster.
Subject: cathedral gargoyle crouched on a ledge.
Style: gothic stone carving.

requests.what: A gothic carved brow crown: three small pointed stone finials with chipped edges, centered above the forehead, dark slate with pale worn tips.
Four raised gothic wing ribs on the left wing, following the wing fingers from shoulder to tips; charcoal stone ribs with light grey worn ridges.
Four raised gothic wing ribs on the right wing, mirrored from the left, charcoal stone with pale chipped highlights.
A large six-lobed cathedral rosette emblem carved into the upper chest, with a deep black recess, raised slate petals, and a small pale stone hub.
A tiny cold blue-violet magical ember seated deep in the left eye socket, surrounded by a dark carved socket rim.
A tiny cold blue-violet magical ember seated deep in the right eye socket, surrounded by a dark carved socket rim.
A compact gothic stone scroll ornament at the front corner of the ledge: curled blocky volutes and a small pointed trefoil, simpler than the gargoyle.
Three oversized hooked talon caps on the left forefoot, angular black stone claws with pale worn tips, planted firmly on the ledge.
Three oversized hooked talon caps on the right forefoot, mirrored angular black stone claws with pale worn tips.
Paint the main body stone in two flat gothic slate tones: warm grey on upward planes, blue-black in recesses, with sparse pale lichen flecks and broad chipped wear on shoulders and spine.
Paint the left wing membrane as dark weathered basalt, with alternating charcoal panels and desaturated grey along the outer scalloped edge.
Paint the right wing membrane to match the left: dark basalt panels, blue-black recesses, and pale weathering on the outer edge.
Paint the ledge as old cathedral masonry with broad rectangular ashlar blocks, black mortar seams, pale rain-worn top planes, and moss in the rear creases.
